tiers.metadata: Counted directly from stored registries/artifacts; no network, no image inspection.
tiers.sample_estimate: Extrapolated from a bounded, deterministic sample of source URLs.
tiers.individually_verified: Fetched, hashed and (for two of them) visually inspected.
tiers.derived_link: Section identity derived from another source for the same model + part; never VERIFIED.

claims.detail: Upper bound before the variant/ambiguity gates; the safe count is lower (see candidates).

contradictions.what: Phase 77A reports 512 linked parts, but the linked_sections payload contains a different number of distinct part numbers.
contradictions.resolution: 77A counts one part per linked section (a part can appear in several sections). The distinct count is authoritative for coverage.

contradictions.what: Phase 77A reports 710 linked positions; the distinct position tuples in the payload can differ from the section-row sum.
contradictions.resolution: Position tuples are unique per (model, section, position); coverage statements must use the distinct set.

contradictions.what: Phase 77B quotes 1,993 fitments / 775 parts / 223 models as if they were usable links.
contradictions.resolution: These are ungated upper bounds. Phase 77C applies the five gates and reports the safe subset separately.
